description: This file defines the class `ViewAdminsettings`, which extends `SugarView`. It handles the display and processing of the administration settings page for the SugarFeed module in SuiteCRM, including enabling/disabling feeds, processing form submissions, and rendering the Smarty template.

classes.name: ViewAdminsettings
classes.description: A view class for rendering the administration settings page related to SugarFeed, handling form submissions, and updating feed configurations.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the module tab name 'Administration' for the view header.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, including a link to the admin index page and the module name.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main function which retrieves settings, processes form submissions related to feed enabling/disabling and record deletion, and renders the Smarty template for admin settings.
